facts.statement: The wallet inventory for 2026-Q2 lists three wallets/accounts: wallet_eth_treasury (self-custody, included), acct_btc_custodian (custodian, included), and wallet_test_legacy (self-custody, excluded).
A message containing a dated challenge nonce was signed by the key for 0x1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef12345678 on 2026-06-30 and the signature record was verified by treasury operations.

The entity mapping register maps all three wallets/accounts to DemoCo Treasury LLC, with mapping sources (treasury policy wallet register, custody agreement, engineering test wallet register) and controller approval dated 2026-01-15.
The period-end balance for wallet_eth_treasury is 1,250.5 ETH as of 2026-06-30 per the wallet inventory, referenced against a block explorer snapshot.
The period-end balance for acct_btc_custodian is 85.25 BTC as of 2026-06-30 per the custodian statement.
wallet_test_legacy is flagged as an engineering test wallet with a zero balance at period end.
